text:
maya (Marketing): Quick creative ask — need a compact benchmark hero for webinar landing + email header + social tile. Goals: two messaging frames (latency-first, cost-first), tiny sparkline (tokens/sec vs $/k), and a no-CTA brand variant. Deadline Thu EOD.

sam (Design): sizes + formats? svg + png + mobile crops?

maya (Marketing): desktop 1200x600, mobile 640x360, square 800x800. svg + png 2x. also a 3-frame GIF for the sparkline. keep headline 6-9 words, subhead 12-16 words.

ben (Growth): also need a transparent PNG for overlays and a plaintext file with approved short CTAs. Audience split: devs (latency/SDK) vs buyers (cost/SLA).

sam (Design): will do two layout systems: metric-led (big stat + sparkline) and narrative-led (short sentence + stat). adding a modular badge slot for "Dedicated" or "SLA". will provide two colorways (brand blue + dark invert).

rachel (Legal): quick note: avoid absolutes like "cheapest" or "always". use qualifiers: "up to", "on typical workloads". include a tiny methodology footnote/link. I can review short copy in ~1 hour.

assets-bot: uploaded draft_v1.zip to /Shared/marketing/compact-bench/draft_v1.zip (contains fig, exports, README).

maya (Marketing): Perfect. Please upload Figma when ready and ping this thread — scheduling review at 12:30 tomorrow. Thanks all!
